title: State of Soroban, 21 days
intro: A 21 day quest to find what slows Soroban builders down, measure it from public data, and ship something for each finding. Every day lists the numbers, the evidence you can click, and what we shipped.

days.finding: 670 public Soroban repos have CI workflows that deploy or invoke contracts. 229 of them sign with a single GitHub secret used as the key, and 96 of those also target mainnet. That is the setup where multisig fits best.
days.shipped: A GitHub Action for Stellar Stratum, built on Stratum's own library. CI proposes the deploy transaction, the team reviews and signs it in Stratum, and no single key ships alone.

days.finding: Raven answers from the Stellar docs and its pinned skills. We ranked every soroban-sdk API by how many non-fork Soroban repos call it, then checked the docs and the pinned skills. The biggest gaps are two deprecated test APIs, register_contract (2,477 repos) and register_stellar_asset_contract (651 repos), which neither the docs nor the skills mention, and 5 docs pages that still call the deprecated events publish. A compiler build against soroban-sdk 30.0.0 confirms the deprecations.
days.shipped: A draft PR to Raven that turns our SDK feed into findings in Raven's own format, with four records and probes that report when the docs change. Two issues to Stellar Light with read-only probes, one for active repos it does not index and one for a last-commit date that lags GitHub.
